column1: # Rule overrides for the frontend pass of gate.yml's zap job (frontend/src served as GitHub
# Pages serves it, e2e/lighthouse/serve-pages.mjs). Format: <rule id><TAB><FAIL|WARN|INFO|IGNORE><TAB># <reason>.
# Unlisted rules default to WARN and never fail the job (-I); only FAIL blocks.
# GitHub Pages sends no custom headers, so the CSP is a <meta> tag (#560) and these header-only rules cannot be met by a static host.

column3: # X-Frame-Options Header Not Set -- static host, no custom headers; frame-ancestors needs a header too
# Content-Security-Policy Header Not Set -- meta CSP only (index.html), see #560
# Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set -- added at the Pages edge, invisible to a plain-HTTP local scan
# X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing -- header only, no static-host equivalent
# Permissions Policy Header Not Set -- header only, no static-host equivalent
# Cross-Origin-{Embedder,Opener,Resource}-Policy Header Missing -- header only, no static-host equivalent
